summary: Another player regains one use of an expended per-life ability, up to its maximum; not Empower, Confidence or Restoration.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: One use of any per-life ability the target has expended; cannot exceed the ability's maximum uses (N1).

requirements.note: Does not function on Empower, Confidence, or Restoration.

references.name: Empower
references.note: Cannot be used to regain Empower.

references.name: Confidence
references.note: Cannot be used to regain Confidence.

references.name: Restoration
references.note: Cannot be used to regain Restoration.

clarifications.text: Does not allow a player to have more than their maximum uses of an ability.

open_questions: E1 does not say who chooses which expended per-life ability regains a use (caster or target).
